column1: T18a-1,D54d,u21-st-rem-object-reference.body,"Я люблю́ себя́ — I love myself. Я люблю́ (свою́) жену́ — I love my wife. In the first sentence the object refers back to the subject. In the second the object is a wife
column2: the parenthesized possessive makes ownership explicit. Loving oneself and loving a wife describe different objects.

column2: the person wounded is different from the subject. In both wounded sentences the object is a person, not a possessed wife.
